_comment: Hermiq capability matrix. Authored here; the cross-product index in market-intelligence is generated from it. Generated by a lane script on 2026-09-26 from authored rows, code-reading packs (two hops: route, API wrapper, calling component) and the intelligence database's competitor feature rows; see the PR body for the method, the row-source split and the column choice. Nobody has driven any competitor for this matrix.
category: A self-hosted platform for autonomous AI agents that lives inside Nextcloud. An organisation defines agents (instructions, model, tools, memory, skills), runs them in chat, on a schedule, from a webhook or from a flow, delivers their output into Nextcloud Talk, and governs every run: human approval, kill switches, guardrails, budgets, an audit trail on OpenRegister and an EU AI Act register. Its category is the agent platform: the ground Microsoft Copilot Studio holds for Microsoft 365 organisations, and that self-hosted builders (Dify, n8n's AI agents, Open WebUI with automations) and the Hermes agent it ports hold for teams that run their own. Inside Nextcloud the reference point a buyer already has is Nextcloud Assistant with its Context Agent, which is interactive only. It is NOT a model server (Ollama, LocalAI), an LLM observability tool (Langfuse, AgentOps), an AI governance suite (Credo AI, watsonx.governance) or a general workflow engine (Airflow, Temporal), although the intelligence database links it to all of those. If this paragraph is wrong, the columns and areas below are wrong with it: correct it here first.
